gap_analysis.miniork_today: mini_ork/orchestration/ (conductor, runner, item-fanout, topology) plus recipes/ with 50+ DAGs including researcher-implementer-reviewer chains (recipes/recursive-self-improve/, recipes/audit-judge-panel-3l/). docs/architecture/artifact-graph.md:23-27 defines the edge-as-completion-gate contract. The AGENTS.md-equivalent lives in each recipe's kickoff.
gap_analysis.gap: No 'team preset' abstraction above the recipe. No IDE panel showing 'coordinator + 3 specialists' as a single entity. No one-command team spawn. Capability is atomic but not visible.

gap_analysis.miniork_today: mini_ork/memory/ (preferences.py, retirement.py, semantic.py, store.py) plus docs/PYTHON-SDK.md:25-29 exposes verified-outcome memory as a primitive — a stronger primitive than OpenClaw's plaintext MEMORY.md. docs/architecture/verification-stack.md anchors the verdict on what the code did.
gap_analysis.gap: No continuous sweep; no diary; no bootstrap from MEMORY.md on a fresh session. Capability (verified memory) exists and is invisible; the consolidation loop is absent.

gap_analysis.miniork_today: mini_ork/integrations/ has discord.py (47K), slack.py (33K), telegram.py (20K), plus _base.py and _ws.py. mini_ork/pm/ exposes the PM mirror that reads Linear/Jira/GitHub but read-only.
gap_analysis.gap: No chat-like inbound from PM sources. Operator cannot answer an awaiting-input prompt from a Linear ticket. Omnipresence surface is three chat channels plus a read-only PM mirror.

gap_analysis.miniork_today: mini_ork/dispatch/llm_dispatch.py (49.9K) + routing.py (16.9K) + cost_pause.py + throttle_guard.py. mini_ork/lane_router.py does GRPO advantage + UCB routing. mini_ork/lane_helpers.py carries the specialist-lane helpers.
gap_analysis.gap: No IDE verb to swap lanes mid-run. No transcript-preservation rule for partial outputs on rate-limit (OpenClaw's model-failover.md:21-26 explicitly preserves partial output). Dispatch is real; the surface is one CLI flag deep.

gap_analysis.miniork_today: mini_ork/orchestration/ owns the node sequence; mini_ork/ide_pages/thread.py is the thread action surface; docs/architecture/artifact-graph.md:23-27 makes the edge a completion gate.

gap_analysis.miniork_today: recipes/ has 50+ DAGs with task_class.yaml + workflow.yaml + artifact_contract.yaml manifests. mini_ork/extensions.py exposes the extension registry and recipe builder. mini_ork/registry-audit/recipe-list (via recipes/registry-audit/) is the only 'list recipes' surface today.
gap_analysis.gap: No skills pane; no per-skill manifest format; no 'browse 50 capabilities and pick one' surface. Recipes are loaded by classification, not by browsing.

gap_analysis.miniork_today: Nothing — mini_ork/ has no platform-bridging module; recipes/ has no computer-use recipe; docs/architecture/ has no node-host design.
gap_analysis.gap: Everything missing — per-platform binaries, screenshot pipeline, screencast relay, click/type primitives, sandbox, audit trail. Capability is fully absent.

open_questions: Is mini-ork's audience the engineer-who-runs-recipes or the operator-who-watches-agents? OpenClaw's headline is the second; mini-ork's posture is the first. K1/K4/K5/K6 require the second; if 'first,' K2 (project-scoped memory) and K7 (skills pane) carry more weight than K1.

Will the IDE surface be a primary differentiator or a secondary artifact? K1/K4/K5/K6 all assume primary (mini-ork already has 35 IDE page files, suggesting yes). If yes, K4 is the cheapest demo per line of code; if no, K7 is the cheapest entry.

Does mini-ork want a marketplace? OpenClaw's ClawHub is the marketplace for skills/plugins. K7 is much higher-impact if mini-ork commits to a 'skills marketplace' surface; much lower if recipes stay classification-driven. Decision must precede K7's first step.

What is the trust posture for destructive ops? K6's approval UX assumes gates already block destructive work. mini_ork's intervention_gate.py is the candidate; the open question is whether the gate list is the right surface, or whether mini-ork needs a separate 'dangerous verb' classifier.

How is 'long-lived persona' framed without crossing into personal-assistant territory? K2's risk depends on this. If 'project-only, operator-curated,' K2 ships; if 'persona-wide, model-decided,' K2 fails the synthesis guardrail and should be re-scoped or dropped.
